title: [Master]-[Drop shipment reversal] Undo Shipment fails with blank Bin Code at bin-mandatory location
summary: Fixed an issue where undoing shipments failed with blank Bin Code errors at bin-mandatory warehouse locations, particularly for drop shipment reversals.
key_points: Resolves errors when reversing drop shipments in bin-mandatory locations
Updates undo logic for both sales shipments and purchase receipts
Adds test cases to validate the fix for item tracking scenarios
